name: net_spawn_emission_hb750_3p
description: VUH-2302: clear and converge the entry pack, prove both friends inside native HB750 geometry with host outside, then require all five host-announced records and matching native Camo Cannon 2407 HP before killing the wave. Existing read-only construction tracing diagnoses null factory returns. No controller/cache/save writes.

steps.expr: all((bridge(i).get(f'puppet{j}') or {}).get('active') for i in range(3) for j in range(2))
all(location(i)==[4,21,0,1,26,32767] and any(a['name']=='P_EX100' for a in actors(i)) for i in range(3))
len(enemy_hps(0))==3 and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)==enemy_hps(2)
all(len(enemy_hps(i))==0 for i in range(3))
[(peek(0x2A0F7DC,'f32',i),peek(0x2A0F830,'f32',i)) for i in range(3)]
[[c for c in saved['geometry750']['snapshots'][0]['peers'][str(i)]['causeContext']['controllers'] if c.get('headerFields',{}).get('headerId')==750][0] for i in range(3)]
all(c['geometry']['complete'] and c['geometry']['bytesStable'] and c['key']==saved['controllers750'][0]['key'] for c in saved['controllers750'])
steps.message: All three peers must expose the same live controller 750 with stable native region geometry

steps.expr: [c['geometry']['regions'][0] for c in saved['controllers750']]
[saved['controllers750'][0]['geometry']['descriptors'][saved['regions750'][0]['descriptorIndex']]['position'][j]+(80 if j==1 else 0) for j in range(3)]
[runtime_log(i).count('Desync notice') for i in range(3)]
len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] sent .*header=750 ',0))==0
steps.message: Host must start outside the 750 emission region

steps.expr: [pos('P_EX100',i) for i in range(3)]
[[sum(saved['regions750'][i]['inverseMatrix'][j+k*4]*saved['friends_in750'][i][k] for k in range(3))+saved['regions750'][i]['inverseMatrix'][j+12] for j in range(3)] for i in range(3)]

all((saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='BOX' and all(abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][j])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j] for j in range(3))) or (saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='CYLINDER' and abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][1])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][1] and sum((saved['friends_local750'][i][j]/saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j])**2 for j in (0,2))<1) for i in (1,2))
steps.message: Both friends must be strictly inside controller 750's actual native region

steps.expr: not (all((saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='BOX' and all(abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][j])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j] for j in range(3))) or (saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='CYLINDER' and abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][1])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][1] and sum((saved['friends_local750'][i][j]/saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j])**2 for j in (0,2))<1) for i in (0,)))
steps.message: The host must remain outside the same native controller-750 region during the friend-only entry control

steps.expr: len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] sent .*header=750 ',0))==0 and all(len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client emitted .*header=750 ',i))==0 for i in (1,2))
steps.message: Friends reaching 750 must not emit a wave before the host enters

steps.expr: [[(a['objectId'],a['hp'],a['address']) for a in enemies(i) if a['objectId']==2407 and a['hp']>0] for i in range(3)]

len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] sent .*header=750 record=0 ',0))>0 and all(len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client emitted .*header=750 record=0\b',i))>0 for i in (1,2)) and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)==enemy_hps(2)
[(peek(0x2A0F7DC,'f32',i),peek(0x2A0F830,'f32',i)) for i in range(3)]

all(len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] sent .*header=750 record='+str(r)+r' ',0))==1 and all(len(log_matches(r'\[spawn-emission\] client emitted .*header=750 record='+str(r)+r'\b',i))==1 for i in (1,2)) for r in range(5)) and len(enemy_hps(0))==5 and enemy_hps(0)==enemy_hps(1)==enemy_hps(2)
[sorted((a['objectId'],a['hp'],a['maxHp']) for a in enemies(i) if a['hp']>0) for i in range(3)]
all(sum(a[0]==2407 for a in peer)==3 and sum(a[0]==2405 for a in peer)==2 for peer in saved['camo_parity']) and saved['camo_parity'][0]==saved['camo_parity'][1]==saved['camo_parity'][2]
steps.message: All five native controller750 bodies, including three Camo Cannons, must match HP on every peer

steps.expr: all(len(enemy_hps(i))==0 for i in range(3))
saved['prehost_camo']==[[],[],[]] and all(log_count('unsupported producer=outside-update',i)==0 for i in range(3))
steps.message: No friend-only Camo before the host wave and no unsupported script emission

steps.expr: [runtime_log(i).count('Desync notice') for i in range(3)]==saved['notices_start']
steps.message: No population desync through the host-authorized wave
